location.evidence_quote: Swedish students from the universities in Umeå, Stockholm, and Gothenburg traveling for international exchange studies
location.section: Materials and Methods — Subject selection and specimen collection
location.notes: Refers to home universities of participants, not travel destination or sampling site.

subject_id.notes: No individual subject identifiers given in main text; Table S1/S4 (supplemental) may contain per-subject data but is not provided.

sample_id.notes: No individual sample identifiers reported in main text.

subcohort.evidence_quote: Seventeen traveled to Central Africa and 18 to the Indian peninsula
subcohort.notes: Two travel-destination subcohorts defined by the study.

control.notes: Study design is before/after travel, not a case-control design; no explicit control/case labeling of samples.

country.evidence_quote: fecal specimens collected at a median of 4 days before departure ... and 22 days ... after return to Sweden
country.notes: Specimens were self-submitted before departure and after return to Sweden, implying sample collection occurred in Sweden; participants are described as 'Swedish students'.

body_site.evidence_quote: self-submission of separate fecal specimens for metagenomic analysis and culture screening for ESBL-producing Enterobacteriaceae
body_site.section: Materials and Methods — Subject selection and specimen collection

days_from_first_collection.evidence_quote: median of 4 days before departure (range 0 to 23) and 22 days (range 2 to 120) after return to Sweden
days_from_first_collection.notes: Only aggregate median/range collection timing reported across cohort; no single per-sample value for days from first collection.

westernized.evidence_quote: Swedish students from the universities in Umeå, Stockholm, and Gothenburg traveling for international exchange studies
westernized.section: Materials and Methods — Subject selection and specimen collection
westernized.notes: Inferred from Swedish/European origin of study population; not explicitly labeled 'westernized' in text.

ncbi_accession.evidence_quote: Sequence data have been submitted to the European Nucleotide Archive under accession number PRJEB7369.

age.notes: Only an age range (23-34 years) is reported, not individual ages.

age_group.evidence_quote: Subjects were 23 to 34 years old, with a gender distribution of 74% females
age_group.notes: Age range 23-34 falls entirely within Adult category (>=18 & <65 years).

ancestry.notes: Nationality (Swedish) reported but not ancestry per se.

sex.notes: Only aggregate sex distribution (74% female) reported for the whole cohort; no per-sample sex values available, so a single enum value cannot be assigned.

age_years.notes: Only an age range is provided, not a single age-in-years value per subject.

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: None of the subjects included were allowed to have taken antibiotics within 6 months prior to fecal sampling.
antibiotics_current_use.section: Materials and Methods — Subject selection and specimen collection
antibiotics_current_use.notes: Also stated in Discussion: 'none of the subjects took antibiotics before or during travel.'

disease.evidence_quote: As many as 69% of subjects (12/17 in the Central Africa group and 12/18 in the Indian peninsula group) had travelers' diarrhea during their trip
disease.notes: Travelers' diarrhea incidence reported as an aggregate proportion per subgroup during travel; not a stable per-subject disease status, and baseline health status not explicitly labeled 'Healthy'.

disease_details.evidence_quote: Swedish students from the universities in Umeå, Stockholm, and Gothenburg traveling for international exchange studies were invited to participate
disease_details.section: Materials and Methods — Subject selection and specimen collection
disease_details.notes: No disease is reported for participants; they are described as healthy student travelers with exclusion criteria (no antibiotics within 6 months). Inferred 'Healthy' status, not explicitly stated.

disease_response_orr.notes: Not applicable; study is not a treatment-response trial.

feces_phenotype.evidence_quote: As many as 69% of subjects (12/17 in the Central Africa group and 12/18 in the Indian peninsula group) had travelers' diarrhea
feces_phenotype.notes: Interpreted as a fecal/stool-related phenotype reported during travel; not a lab stool test.

fmt_id.notes: No FMT procedure described in this study.

treatment.evidence_quote: All travelers to Central Africa and 44% (8/18) of travelers to the Indian peninsula used antimalarial chemoprophylaxis.
treatment.notes: Study explicitly states no antibiotics were used ('none of the subjects took antibiotics before or during travel'); the only reported medication/treatment class is antimalarial chemoprophylaxis (e.g., mefloquine, proguanil, atovaquone mentioned in Discussion).

feces_phenotype_value.evidence_quote: As many as 69% of subjects (12/17 in the Central Africa group and 12/18 in the Indian peninsula group) had travelers' diarrhea
feces_phenotype_value.notes: 69% derived from combining 12/17 and 12/18 (24/35) subjects reporting travelers' diarrhea; paired with feces_phenotype entry.

tumor_size_residual_measurement.notes: Not applicable to this study (no tumor-related content).

study_name.notes: No canonical study identifier (e.g., 'AuthorX_YYYY') is given in the text.

pmid.notes: PMID not explicitly stated within the provided paper text; paper_id (26259788) supplied externally as metadata, not extracted from body text.

target_condition.evidence_quote: we used explorative shotgun metagenomic sequencing to address the abundance of >300 antibiotic resistance genes in fecal specimens
target_condition.notes: Study also examines ESBL-producing enterobacteria acquisition as a related phenotype; both reflect the primary conditions investigated.

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: None of the subjects included were allowed to have taken antibiotics within 6 months prior to fecal sampling.
antibiotics_exclusion_period.section: Materials and Methods — Subject selection and specimen collection

antibiotics_exclusion_period_unit.evidence_quote: None of the subjects included were allowed to have taken antibiotics within 6 months prior to fecal sampling.
antibiotics_exclusion_period_unit.section: Materials and Methods — Subject selection and specimen collection

dna_extraction_kit.notes: Detailed DNA extraction method is referred to supplemental material, not included in provided text.

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: DNA was extracted from the fecal specimens and sequenced using Illumina HiSeq 2000 technology.
sequencing_platform.section: Materials and Methods — Subject selection and specimen collection
sequencing_platform.notes: A second platform, Illumina MiSeq (250-bp paired-end reads), was used for ESBL isolate genome sequencing; only the primary metagenomic platform (HiSeq) is reported here.

host_species.evidence_quote: fecal specimens from 35 Swedish students taken before and after exchange programs
